rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. Both are unusually personal Treasury-secretary resignation letters built around the inadequacy of words to express gratitude, the appointee's earlier arrival at Treasury, work on major fiscal problems, continued personal contact or future counsel, and warm wishes extending to the recipient's family. C06 is the strongest contemporaneous batch template for the child's administrative middle: acceptance effective January 20, praise for leadership and staff, an accomplishments paragraph keyed to the secretary's report, and closing wishes. C04 shares distinctive formulations about the difficulty of overstating the official's value and maintaining future contact, but its overall structure is less closely aligned than C16.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I shah never be able to tell you of the depth of my gratitude for your readiness to return three and a half years ago to governmental service as Secretary of the Treasury.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It would be idle to attempt expression of my feelings of gratitude for the extraordinary talents that, more than four years ago, you brought to the Treasury Department
shared_material.explanation: Both open their substantive tribute by declaring gratitude difficult to express, connecting it to the recipient's arrival at Treasury a specified number of years earlier.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under your leadership the Treasury has provided constructive guidance in this Administration's efforts to stabilize the dollar, balance the Federal budget, correct the balance of payments deficit, plan for tax revision and simplification, and manage the Federal debt.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: you have, ever since, applied them to problems of the greatest import... developing financial plans and programs which you and I jointly have deemed to be in the best interests of our country
shared_material.explanation: Both center the tribute on the Treasury secretary's work developing and managing the administration's fiscal program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I earnestly hope that opportunities will develop from time to time for you and me to meet
shared_material.parent_excerpt: From time to time I know we shall want to call upon you for advice and counsel
shared_material.explanation: The shared 'from time to time' formulation presents the post-resignation relationship as continuing through future meetings or counsel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: To you and your family, I send my warm regard and, of course, my very best wishes
shared_material.parent_excerpt: With affectionate regard to you both
shared_material.explanation: Both close with unusually personal regard extended to the departing Treasury secretary and family, reinforcing the broader personal template.
